name: Forge (dev factory)
tagline: Hand it a spec you have signed off, and collect the pull request in the morning
description: The work it picks up is whatever you have marked as settled, so nothing starts on a brief that is still being argued over. From there it drafts an approach, writes the code, reads its own output back critically and opens the change for review - unattended, through the small hours, waiting for you at your desk.
author: DanKillenberger
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
